screen-sharing.q: Will the teleprompter appear in my Loom recording?
screen-sharing.a: No. Loom records your screen through macOS screen capture, and the prompter window is excluded from it. Your camera bubble is unaffected.

extraFaqs.q: Can I keep the script near my camera bubble?
extraFaqs.a: Yes. Drag the window wherever your Loom camera bubble sits; the follow-cursor mode also keeps it under your pointer while you demo.

extraFaqs.q: How do I use a teleprompter with Loom?
extraFaqs.a:
1. Start your script in {{APP_NAME}} from the clipboard.
  2. Place the window near Loom's camera bubble.
  3. Start the Loom recording (screen + cam).
  4. Read naturally; the prompter is not in the recording.
